import selfies as sf
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
from pyscf import gto, dft
s='[C][C][Branch1][Ring2][C][C][O][C][C][C][#C]'
sm=sf.decoder(s)
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(sm))
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=17
if AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)!=0: raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
conf=m.Get conformer() if False else m.GetConformer()
coords=conf.GetPositions()
atoms=[(a.GetSymbol(),tuple(coords[a.GetIdx()])) for a in m.GetAtoms()]
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms,basis='6-31g*',charge=0,spin=0,verbose=0)
ks=dft.RKS(mol); ks.xc='b3lyp'; ks.conv_tol=1e-9; ks.max_cycle=100
energy=ks.kernel()
occ=np.where(ks.mo_occ>0)[0]
idx=int(occ[-1])
print('SELFIES',s)
print('SMILES',sm)
print('Canonical SMILES',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
print('Method B3LYP/6-31G* single point; input geometry RDKit MMFF94s optimized conformer; gas phase')
print('SCF converged',ks.converged,'total_energy_Hartree',energy)
print('HOMO_index',idx,'HOMO_energy_Hartree',float(ks.mo_energy[idx]))
